name: sytecheck-mcp
description: Scan a website for SEO, accessibility, performance and security issues, and read the report.
long_description:
SyteCheck scans a page across ten dimensions — HTML validity, SEO, broken links, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA via axe-core), performance (a real Lighthouse run), security headers, responsive layout, AI visibility, content freshness, and an AI critique of the visual design — and returns a scored, plain-language report.

A free SyteCheck account works: three scans a month across three categories, no card. Note that running a scan spends quota, so `run_scan` is marked as not read-only and your client will ask before each one. If you want a key that can only read existing scans, mint a `scans:read` key instead.

api_key.title: SyteCheck API key
api_key.description: Created at Account -> API keys on sytecheck.app. Begins with sck_. Choose a scans:read key if you want reports read but no quota spent.

api_url.description: Only change this to point at a non-production SyteCheck instance.
